verdict.rationale: RUN's own docs say pay is automatically deposited into each employee's account on payday, and new hires can enter their own direct deposit details, so direct deposit replaces paper checks. The evidence never states the deposit speed or lead time, so the 'fast (next-day or 2-day)' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: documented next-day or 2-day direct deposit timing or processing lead time, independent or hands-on corroboration of deposit speed.

support.subject: As a founder, I can pay employees by fast (next-day or 2-day) direct deposit instead of writing checks
